checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Dark green text reads 'Little Sprout' clearly and is spelled correctly.

must.item: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
must.why: A two-leaf green sprout with a short stem sits centered above the text.
The background is white, or very close to it, with no texture or other elements.

must.item: The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.
must.why: It is a square, flat vector-style logo. The leaves have slight gradients, but it is not a mockup.

faults.what: The background is a very slightly off-white and not pure white. It is barely noticeable.
The leaves have subtle gradients, so the style is not strictly flat. This is a small point.
The logo is small within the canvas and leaves a lot of empty margin.

summary: A clean square logo with a green two-leaf sprout above correctly spelled "Little Sprout" on a white background, matching the brief with only minor nitpicks.
